meta.title: Izanagi AI — The runtime that orchestrates engineering agents
meta.description: Agent and skill framework for autonomous software engineering: 21 specialized agents, adaptive routing, evaluation, self-healing and persistent memory.

hero.subtitle: Izanagi is the runtime that routes, orchestrates, evaluates and heals 21 specialized agents — from the first requirement to deploy.

problem.title: One AI agent alone isn't enough.
problem.body: Generic prompts produce generic code. Without architecture, without evaluation and without memory between runs, every task starts from zero — and repeats the same mistakes.

whatIsIt.title: A decision layer between you and the code.
whatIsIt.body: Every task passes through five layers before it becomes a line of code.

routing.title: Routing
routing.desc: Analyzes the task and automatically selects the right agent and skills.

orchestration.title: Orchestration
orchestration.desc: Composes chains of skills and agents into an execution graph.

evaluation.title: Evaluation
evaluation.desc: Measures every delivery against weighted metrics and an objective verdict.

healing.title: Self-Healing
healing.desc: Detects failures at runtime and corrects course on its own.

agentsSection.title: A specialist for every decision.
agentsSection.body: From requirements discovery to production deploy — every domain has a dedicated agent, chained through skill compositions.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.desc: Pre-production: interview, real reference research and a rich prompt before any code.

product-reasoner.title: Product Reasoner
product-reasoner.desc: Turns vague intent into evidence-backed requirements and BDD acceptance criteria.

pm.title: PM
pm.desc: Breaks epics into deliverables, sprints, dependencies and a risk matrix.

researcher.title: Researcher
researcher.desc: In-depth investigation with cited sources and a confidence level.

architect.title: Architect
architect.desc: Large-scale system design, Clean Architecture, DDD, CQRS and ADRs.

senior-engineer.title: Senior Engineer
senior-engineer.desc: Full-stack, end-to-end implementation, strict TDD, zero stubs.

techlead.title: Tech Lead
techlead.desc: Pedagogical code review across 5 dimensions and standards governance.

database.title: Database
database.desc: Relational and NoSQL modeling, advanced indexing, zero-downtime migrations.

devops.title: DevOps
devops.desc: CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, IaC and observability.

security.title: Security
security.desc: OWASP Top 10, robust authentication and API hardening.

automation-engineer.title: Automation Engineer
automation-engineer.desc: Professional automation with idempotency, retries and structured logging.

form-engineer.title: Form Engineer
form-engineer.desc: Validated forms, multi-step wizards and accessibility.

qa.title: QA
qa.desc: Unit tests, integration, resilient E2E and quality gates.

bug-hunter.title: Bug Hunter
bug-hunter.desc: 6-phase debugging with root cause analysis and regression tests.

evaluator.title: Evaluator
evaluator.desc: Objective evaluation of deliverables with metrics and a verdict.

adversarial-critic.title: Adversarial Critic
adversarial-critic.desc: Adversarial critique hunting bugs, security flaws and overengineering.

animation.title: Animation
animation.desc: Scrollytelling, WebGL 3D and cinematic motion signature.

docs.title: Docs
docs.desc: READMEs, Diátaxis-based documentation and architecture diagrams.

professor.title: Professor
professor.desc: Adaptive teaching with intuitive analogies and practice exercises.

agent-architect.title: Agent Architect
agent-architect.desc: Designs new specialized agents on demand, without duplication.

skill-architect.title: Skill Architect
skill-architect.desc: Curates new skills, avoiding duplication and proving real gaps.

install.title: Three commands. Zero config.
install.body: Izanagi detects your AI CLI — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot or Kimi — and generates only the adapters you need.
install.note: Published on npm as izanagi-ai — MIT licensed.

changelogTeaser.title: The framework evolves in public.
changelogTeaser.body: Every commit and release shows up here — straight from GitHub, no manual curation.

cta.title: Stop writing prompts. Start orchestrating agents.
cta.body: 21 agents, 212 skills, persistent memory — one command away.

footer.tagline: Architecture before code. Measured quality. Continuous evolution.

changelogPage.subtitle: The repository's latest releases and commits — refreshed automatically every hour.
